<script>
(function() {
  const COLORS = {
    root:       { stroke: "#eab308", fill: "rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.18)" },
    submodules: { stroke: "#38bdf8", fill: "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.13)", label: "Submodules (at init)" },
    data:       { stroke: "#34d399", fill: "rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.13)", label: "Data & Preprocessing" },
    engine:     { stroke: "#a78bfa", fill: "rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.13)", label: "Model & Sampler" },
    posteriors: { stroke: "#fb7185", fill: "rgba(251, 113, 133, 0.13)", label: "Posteriors & Diagnostics" }
  };

  const NODES = [
    // Root
    {
      id: "m", label: "m = bf()", sub: "Session Root", cat: "root", x: 440, y: 210, w: 126, h: 48,
      type: "BayesForge.bf", stage: "Created by bf()",
      desc: "Central BayesForge session object holding your dataset, modeling building blocks, MCMC/SVI sampler, persistence (save/load), posterior samples, and diagnostic tools.",
      links: [{ text: "Session API (m.*)", href: "session.html" }, { text: "m.fit()", href: "session.html#fit" }, { text: "m.save()", href: "session.html#save" }, { text: "m.load()", href: "session.html#load" }]
    },

    // 1. Submodules (Top-Left)
    {
      id: "dist", label: "m.dist", sub: "Distributions", cat: "submodules", x: 135, y: 52, w: 185, h: 36,
      type: "DistProxy (UnifiedDist)", stage: "Available at bf()",
      desc: "50+ probability distributions (normal, binomial, poisson, lkj_cholesky, ...) used to declare priors (name=), likelihoods (obs=), or simulate data (sample=True).",
      links: [{ text: "Distributions API (m.dist.*)", href: "dist.html" }]
    },
    {
      id: "effects", label: "m.effects", sub: "Random effects", cat: "submodules", x: 135, y: 96, w: 185, h: 36,
      type: "effects", stage: "Available at bf()",
      desc: "Building blocks for hierarchical / varying effects (centered and non-centered varying intercepts and slopes, correlated LKJ blocks).",
      links: [{ text: "Random effects API (m.effects.*)", href: "effects.html" }]
    },
    {
      id: "link", label: "m.link", sub: "Link functions", cat: "submodules", x: 135, y: 140, w: 185, h: 36,
      type: "link", stage: "Available at bf()",
      desc: "Inverse link functions and parameter transforms (inv_logit, exp, softmax, cloglog, ...) for Generalized Linear Models.",
      links: [{ text: "Link functions API (m.link.*)", href: "link.html" }]
    },
    {
      id: "net", label: "m.net", sub: "Network models", cat: "submodules", x: 135, y: 184, w: 185, h: 36,
      type: "net", stage: "Available at bf()",
      desc: "Social network analysis toolkit: Social Relations Model (sender_receiver, dyadic_effect), Stochastic Block Models (block_model), and JAX graph metrics.",
      links: [{ text: "Networks API (m.net.*)", href: "net.html" }]
    },
    {
      id: "load", label: "m.save() / m.load()", sub: "Save, load & datasets", cat: "submodules", x: 135, y: 228, w: 185, h: 36,
      type: "Persistence & Datasets", stage: "Available at bf()",
      desc: "Save the fitted BF session to disk with m.save(path), reload a saved session with m.load(path), or load bundled benchmark datasets via m.load.<dataset>() (howell1, reedfrogs, chimpanzees, ...).",
      links: [{ text: "m.save()", href: "session.html#save" }, { text: "m.load()", href: "session.html#load" }, { text: "Example data (m.load.*)", href: "load.html" }]
    },

    // 2. Data & Preprocessing (Bottom-Left)
    {
      id: "df", label: "m.df", sub: "Pandas DataFrame", cat: "data", x: 135, y: 294, w: 185, h: 36,
      type: "pandas.DataFrame", stage: "Created by m.data()",
      desc: "In-memory DataFrame holding the loaded dataset. Modified in-place when you call m.scale(), m.index(), m.OHE(), m.to_float(), or m.to_int().",
      links: [{ text: "m.data()", href: "data.html#data" }, { text: "m.scale()", href: "data.html#scale" }, { text: "m.index()", href: "data.html#index" }, { text: "m.OHE()", href: "data.html#OHE" }]
    },
    {
      id: "data_on_model", label: "m.data_on_model", sub: "JAX model inputs", cat: "data", x: 135, y: 338, w: 185, h: 36,
      type: "dict[str, jax.Array]", stage: "Set by m.data_to_model() / m.fit()",
      desc: "Dictionary of JAX arrays passed as arguments to your model function. Populated explicitly by m.data_to_model(cols) or obs=..., or automatically from m.df via m.pd_to_jax().",
      links: [{ text: "m.data_to_model()", href: "data.html#data_to_model" }, { text: "m.pd_to_jax()", href: "data.html#pd_to_jax" }, { text: "m.fit()", href: "session.html#fit" }]
    },
    {
      id: "index_map", label: "m.index_map", sub: "Category code map", cat: "data", x: 135, y: 382, w: 185, h: 36,
      type: "dict[str, dict[int, str]]", stage: "Created by m.index()",
      desc: "Maps each categorical column encoded by m.index() to its 0-based integer lookup dictionary {code: category_label}, and m.data_modification tracks all column transforms.",
      links: [{ text: "m.index()", href: "data.html#index" }, { text: "Data API", href: "data.html" }]
    },

    // 3. Engine & Fit State (Top-Right)
    {
      id: "model", label: "m.model", sub: "Fitted model fn", cat: "engine", x: 745, y: 52, w: 195, h: 36,
      type: "callable", stage: "Set by m.fit() / m.svi()",
      desc: "The probabilistic model function most recently passed to m.fit() or m.svi(). Used by m.sample(), m.latex(), m.graph(), and m.diag PPC/LOO helpers.",
      links: [{ text: "m.fit()", href: "session.html#fit" }, { text: "m.latex()", href: "session.html#latex" }, { text: "m.graph()", href: "session.html#graph" }, { text: "m.sample()", href: "session.html#sample" }]
    },
    {
      id: "sampler", label: "m.sampler", sub: "MCMC / SVI engine", cat: "engine", x: 745, y: 96, w: 195, h: 36,
      type: "mcmc_numpyro / svi_numpyro", stage: "Set by m.fit() / m.svi()",
      desc: "Underlying sampler wrapper holding the NUTS/HMC/Gibbs kernel or SVI state, warmup adaptation state, and raw chain samples.",
      links: [{ text: "m.fit()", href: "session.html#fit" }, { text: "m.svi()", href: "session.html#svi" }, { text: "m.sampler_stats()", href: "session.html#sampler_stats" }]
    },
    {
      id: "seed", label: "m.seed / m._rng", sub: "PRNG key manager", cat: "engine", x: 745, y: 140, w: 195, h: 36,
      type: "int | bool / RNG", stage: "Set at bf() / m.set_seed()",
      desc: "Controls reproducibility across prior simulation, MCMC warmup/sampling, and posterior predictive draws via a deterministic JAX PRNGKey stream.",
      links: [{ text: "m.get_seed()", href: "session.html#get_seed" }, { text: "m.set_seed()", href: "session.html#set_seed" }]
    },
    {
      id: "mesh", label: "m.n_devices / m.mesh", sub: "Multi-CPU/GPU sharding", cat: "engine", x: 745, y: 184, w: 195, h: 36,
      type: "int / jax.sharding.Mesh", stage: "Set at bf(cores=...)",
      desc: "Device count and XLA mesh for parallel chains and axis-0 data sharding. Placement decisions from m.fit(shard=True) are inspected via m.shard_report().",
      links: [{ text: "m.shard()", href: "session.html#shard" }, { text: "m.replicate()", href: "session.html#replicate" }, { text: "m.shard_report()", href: "session.html#shard_report" }]
    },

    // 4. Posteriors & Diagnostics (Bottom-Right)
    {
      id: "posteriors", label: "m.posteriors", sub: "Pooled draws (active)", cat: "posteriors", x: 745, y: 244, w: 195, h: 34,
      type: "dict[str, jax.Array]", stage: "Set by m.fit() · Updated by m.filter_posteriors()",
      desc: "Dictionary of posterior draws pooled across chains {param: Array(n_draws, ...)}. Updated in-place when m.filter_posteriors() or m.summary(include=/exclude=) is called.",
      links: [{ text: "m.fit()", href: "session.html#fit" }, { text: "m.filter_posteriors()", href: "session.html#filter_posteriors" }, { text: "m.get_posterior_means()", href: "session.html#get_posterior_means" }]
    },
    {
      id: "posteriors_chain", label: "m.posteriors_by_chain", sub: "Per-chain draws (C, S, ...)", cat: "posteriors", x: 745, y: 284, w: 195, h: 34,
      type: "dict[str, jax.Array]", stage: "Set by m.fit() · Updated by m.filter_posteriors()",
      desc: "Posterior draws preserving the leading chain axis (n_chains, n_samples, ...). Used by trace plots, rank plots, R-hat, and ESS calculations.",
      links: [{ text: "m.fit()", href: "session.html#fit" }, { text: "m.filter_posteriors()", href: "session.html#filter_posteriors" }]
    },
    {
      id: "posteriors_full", label: "m.posteriors_full", sub: "Unfiltered backup draws", cat: "posteriors", x: 745, y: 324, w: 195, h: 34,
      type: "dict[str, jax.Array]", stage: "Set by m.fit() (read-only baseline)",
      desc: "Unfiltered copy of all sampled parameters (alongside m.posteriors_by_chain_full). Ensures repeated calls to m.filter_posteriors() always filter from the full model rather than stacking.",
      links: [{ text: "m.filter_posteriors()", href: "session.html#filter_posteriors" }, { text: "m.diag (filtered=False)", href: "diag.html" }]
    },
    {
      id: "tab_summary", label: "m.tab_summary", sub: "Summary DataFrame", cat: "posteriors", x: 745, y: 364, w: 195, h: 34,
      type: "pandas.DataFrame", stage: "Set by m.summary()",
      desc: "Cached summary table (mean, sd, HDI bounds, mcse, ess_bulk, ess_tail, r_hat) produced by the most recent call to m.summary() or m.summary_jax().",
      links: [{ text: "m.summary()", href: "session.html#summary" }, { text: "m.summary_jax()", href: "session.html#summary_jax" }]
    },
    {
      id: "diag", label: "m.diag (& .trace)", sub: "Diagnostics & plots", cat: "posteriors", x: 745, y: 402, w: 195, h: 34,
      type: "diagWIP", stage: "Set by m.fit() / m.svi()",
      desc: "Interactive diagnostics suite bound to m: convergence metrics (rhat, ess, loo, waic), Plotly plots (plot_trace, posterior, forest, pair, ppc_*), and ArviZ InferenceData (m.diag.trace).",
      links: [{ text: "Diagnostics API (m.diag.*)", href: "diag.html" }, { text: "m.diag.to_az()", href: "diag.html#to_az" }, { text: "m.sampler_stats()", href: "session.html#sampler_stats" }]
    }
  ];

  const svg = document.getElementById("bf-obj-svg");
  if (!svg) return;
  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  // Group headers
  const headers = [
    { text: "1. Submodules (at init)", x: 135, y: 22, color: COLORS.submodules.stroke },
    { text: "2. Data & Preprocessing", x: 135, y: 268, color: COLORS.data.stroke },
    { text: "3. Model & Sampler", x: 745, y: 22, color: COLORS.engine.stroke },
    { text: "4. Posteriors & Diagnostics", x: 745, y: 218, color: COLORS.posteriors.stroke }
  ];
  headers.forEach(h => {
    const t = document.createElementNS(NS, "text");
    t.setAttribute("x", h.x);
    t.setAttribute("y", h.y);
    t.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    t.setAttribute("fill", h.color);
    t.setAttribute("class", "bf-group-label");
    t.textContent = h.text;
    svg.appendChild(t);
  });

  const root = NODES[0];
  const edgeElements = [];
  const nodeElements = [];

  // Draw curved edges from root to each node
  NODES.slice(1).forEach(n => {
    const path = document.createElementNS(NS, "path");
    const isLeft = n.x < root.x;
    const x1 = isLeft ? root.x - root.w / 2 : root.x + root.w / 2;
    const y1 = root.y;
    const x2 = isLeft ? n.x + n.w / 2 : n.x - n.w / 2;
    const y2 = n.y;
    const cx1 = x1 + (x2 - x1) * 0.45;
    const cx2 = x1 + (x2 - x1) * 0.55;
    path.setAttribute("d", `M ${x1} ${y1} C ${cx1} ${y1}, ${cx2} ${y2}, ${x2} ${y2}`);
    path.setAttribute("stroke", COLORS[n.cat].stroke);
    path.setAttribute("class", "bf-edge");
    path.dataset.id = n.id;
    path.dataset.cat = n.cat;
    svg.appendChild(path);
    edgeElements.push(path);
  });

  function showPopup(node) {
    document.getElementById("bf-popup-name").textContent = node.label;
    document.getElementById("bf-popup-type").textContent = node.type;
    document.getElementById("bf-popup-stage").textContent = node.stage;
    document.getElementById("bf-popup-desc").textContent = node.desc;
    const linksWrap = document.getElementById("bf-popup-links");
    linksWrap.innerHTML = "<span>Related API:</span>";
    (node.links || []).forEach(l => {
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.className = "bf-popup-link";
      a.href = l.href;
      a.textContent = l.text;
      linksWrap.appendChild(a);
    });
    const card = document.getElementById("bf-popup-card");
    card.style.borderColor = COLORS[node.cat].stroke;

    nodeElements.forEach(el => {
      el.classList.toggle("selected", el.dataset.id === node.id);
    });
    edgeElements.forEach(ed => {
      ed.classList.toggle("highlighted", ed.dataset.id === node.id);
    });
  }

  // Draw nodes
  NODES.forEach(n => {
    const g = document.createElementNS(NS, "g");
    g.setAttribute("class", "bf-node" + (n.id === "m" ? " selected" : ""));
    g.dataset.id = n.id;
    g.dataset.cat = n.cat;

    const rect = document.createElementNS(NS, "rect");
    rect.setAttribute("x", n.x - n.w / 2);
    rect.setAttribute("y", n.y - n.h / 2);
    rect.setAttribute("width", n.w);
    rect.setAttribute("height", n.h);
    rect.setAttribute("rx", n.id === "m" ? 12 : 8);
    rect.setAttribute("fill", COLORS[n.cat].fill);
    rect.setAttribute("stroke", COLORS[n.cat].stroke);
    rect.setAttribute("stroke-width", n.id === "m" ? "2.4" : "1.5");
    g.appendChild(rect);

    const label = document.createElementNS(NS, "text");
    label.setAttribute("x", n.x);
    label.setAttribute("y", n.y - 3);
    label.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    label.setAttribute("class", "bf-node-label");
    label.textContent = n.label;
    g.appendChild(label);

    const sub = document.createElementNS(NS, "text");
    sub.setAttribute("x", n.x);
    sub.setAttribute("y", n.y + 11);
    sub.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    sub.setAttribute("class", "bf-node-sub");
    sub.textContent = n.sub;
    g.appendChild(sub);

    g.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => showPopup(n));
    g.addEventListener("click", () => showPopup(n));
    svg.appendChild(g);
    nodeElements.push(g);
  });

  // Category filter buttons
  document.querySelectorAll("#bf-obj-explorer .bf-filter-btn").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      document.querySelectorAll("#bf-obj-explorer .bf-filter-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
      btn.classList.add("active");
      const cat = btn.dataset.cat;
      nodeElements.forEach(el => {
        const match = cat === "all" || el.dataset.cat === cat || el.dataset.cat === "root";
        el.classList.toggle("dimmed", !match);
      });
      edgeElements.forEach(ed => {
        const match = cat === "all" || ed.dataset.cat === cat;
        ed.classList.toggle("dimmed", !match);
      });
      if (cat !== "all") {
        const first = NODES.find(n => n.cat === cat);
        if (first) showPopup(first);
      } else {
        showPopup(root);
      }
    });
  });
})();
</script>
